payload.scientific_problem: Measure whether the frozen score-blind hybrid top-three macro bootstrap followed by unchanged Dynamic-v0 produces a competitive early T4 trajectory through charged call 20.
payload.primary_output: Five durable lower-is-better docking best-so-far trajectories at calls 1, 5, 10 and 20, with complete query, archive, program-lineage, RNG and resume state.
payload.evidence_boundary: Five answer-known delta-0.4 development cells and one search replicate. This is not a full T4 benchmark, held-out evidence or IVG superiority evidence.

controller.supported_cells: JAK2_1 and PARP1_0 charge the three exact locked macro candidates at calls 1-3 in frozen order, admit each finite observation to one run-local archive, then invoke unchanged Dynamic-v0 at call 4.
controller.unsupported_cells: 5HT1B_0, BRAF_1 and FA7_0 preserve the explicit macro-support abstention and invoke unchanged Dynamic-v0 at call 1.
controller.failed_locked_macro: A failed call remains charged and is not admitted, retried, replaced or backfilled.
controller.dynamic_v0: The proposal law, exact executor, score-blind parent allocation, mutation/recombination, eligibility and archive update remain byte-identical to the bound implementation.
controller.initial_route_archive: Empty except for finite observations produced by the three frozen macro calls during this same run.
controller.rng: Use the admission lock's dynamic_v0_refinement namespace for optimizer proposals and persist the exact bit-generator state after every completed round.

runtime_assets.box_definition: BOXES in the hash-bound scoring implementation
runtime_assets.ligand_preparation: Open Babel --gen3d in the hash-bound production docking wrapper

authorization.modal_bundle_upload_scope: The user authorized Modal use for this bounded five-cell Stage-20 run, but launch remains fail-closed until the clean launch revision, tree and self-hashed contract are surfaced and explicitly accepted by the root agent under the exact-hash launch guard.
authorization.exact_launch_revision_recording: The launcher records the exact accepted clean revision and contract physical SHA-256 in the immutable spawn receipt.

prohibitions: launch before exact clean revision and contract hash authorization
more than 20 charged calls in any cell or 100 total in this stage
automatic retry, replacement, backfill, confirmation or plateau stopping
changing a frozen candidate, candidate order, Dynamic-v0 law, evaluator, seed or eligibility rule
filling a short trajectory after proposal exhaustion or docking failure
continuing to calls 50 or 100 without a separate exact authorization
